title: Universal Totem
description: Turns any held item into a lifesaving Totem of Undying that activates when you receive fatal damage.
body:
Universal Totem

Universal Totem is a lightweight Fabric mod that gives every item in Minecraft the power to save your life.

If you receive fatal damage while holding an item, that item will activate like a Totem of Undying, preventing death and applying the same revival effects.

Instead of requiring a rare totem, any item in your hand can become your last chance to survive.
